content: Ebu Agiripaꞌa Paulo niro, “Ḡae veize ḡoerogaꞌe idaḡa.” Eꞌanoꞌo Pauloꞌa ꞌevoꞌa mae ḡihinadu ḡoere ḡadahiro,
“Kini Agiripa, eꞌe izidi matuꞌeꞌohe, mazaḡa Iuda azaḡaniꞌa ḡoere aduga niduꞌa eḡe rana riꞌineꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, e ḡae zamao eḡeꞌa bare birifine ḡoereꞌohe.
Ḡaꞌe Iuda azaḡa haḡai zu zeḡeꞌa taꞌirotiteꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe faine edereꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo e umiꞌeꞌohe, eḡe ḡoere ꞌahi faine egoꞌi onamo ḡonaga.
Eḡeꞌa komeꞌanonoꞌo nouge radiunutaꞌaꞌe Iuda azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe edeḡa. Ze eḡeꞌa Iuda azaḡa boꞌaḡano ebu Ierusalema zamaḡano nouge radiunutaꞌaꞌe edeḡa.

Ze ḡabonehe ḡadaheḡanonoꞌo edeḡa ꞌahine, zeꞌa uratine, eꞌe Farisea vazeḡa ibiḡano radiu areꞌeteꞌe moneo zeḡeꞌa rae furenoga zuni idaḡa. Farisea azaḡaꞌe Iuda azaḡa niduꞌa boꞌaḡano Mose goro ḡoeꞌa inare hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa.
Ebu izidi eꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe vouḡa mazao ḡoitoriroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudanoga guhineꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, kotao edauꞌohe.

Emeḡe urabo gaubanana aheu fareꞌe eꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudanoga radu guhineꞌohe, ebu ohere zu madai Badiꞌa veize inare gaueꞌohe. Kini Agiripa, e eꞌe ḡoitore ḡoeꞌa guhineꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Iuda azaḡaniꞌa eḡe ꞌuteꞌohe.
Zaꞌe nougadu Badiꞌaꞌa rune azaḡa bare ḡabozeꞌeteꞌe mene mae ḡihineꞌohe?
Eḡe zuni ibite Nazareta vazeḡa Iesu ni ꞌuoga veize inarahe niduꞌa hina gauiꞌuma rae zamariro.
E ꞌuguḡa haḡaiḡa Ierusalemao haḡairo. Ebu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa niḡano Zuhiꞌa Boro mone azaḡa ḡehaḡa ḡuꞌa neḡano ohoziro, zu ze zimi ruzihi rae reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa eḡeꞌa mae ḡihiniro.

Ebu nuꞌonuꞌo neḡa niduꞌa diuḡadu ḡae ḡehaḡa aduga ziniro, ebu ze Iesu niḡa rae sausaunoga veize teꞌoteꞌoziro. Ebu e maḡune rudaroteꞌe uꞌano, haba faḡano ne ꞌahogaꞌahoga onamadu Zuhiꞌa Boro mone azaḡa sausauziro.”
Pauloꞌa Nougenouge Iesu mazao Firoteꞌe Hariḡa rae Fureniro
“Mada ꞌahogano eꞌe ꞌougihi radu dibuꞌo azaḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa niḡano ḡoereze odohadu Damaseko onamiro.
Kini Agiripa, e madai kirikiri Damaseko ibiḡano onameꞌeteꞌea, adureonoꞌo agaḡa boroꞌa agaranoga horoniro. Eꞌe agaḡaꞌe mada agaḡa vitinoga. Eḡe zu eḡe teite onameꞌeteꞌe azaḡa agafi ovairo.
Emeḡe niduꞌa rahao higau bauriro. Ebu e Heberu ḡoeꞌano ihiꞌeteꞌe agoḡa ꞌahoga igiro, 'Saulo, Saulo, ḡa nougadu eḡe sausauheꞌohe? Ḡa ire meigameiga futunine, ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare sausauꞌeꞌohe.'
Ebu eḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, 'Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡa iniu?' Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa naenaehiro, 'Eꞌe Iesu, ḡaeꞌa sausauneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.
Iḡunadu edanoꞌi. Ḡaꞌe eḡe tuḡure vazeḡano ohoꞌifine, zu ḡaeꞌa horonateꞌe hariḡa vaze mazao meꞌodifine, ebu eḡeꞌa ihoꞌiteꞌe ḡoeꞌa rae furenifine, eḡeꞌa ḡae mazao fureraro.
E Iuda azaḡa zu Iuda mene azaḡa mazaonoꞌo ḡa ḡaboꞌadu Iuda mene azaḡa mazao tuḡuꞌiꞌuma.

Aꞌe, ubumaze raꞌanozenadu ze uzabonoꞌo agaḡa moneo mae ḡihuzoga veize, zu Satani ꞌuꞌuḡanonoꞌo mae vaḡizadu Badiꞌa mone rouga veize raꞌohe. ꞌOugine, haḡaize sauꞌa eḡeꞌa rae modiꞌuma, zu zeꞌe eḡe mazao fiadu Badiꞌa mone azaḡa teite ꞌauḡiꞌuma.'”
Pauloꞌa Kotao Haramiro
“Eꞌanoꞌo kini Agiripa, eꞌe adureonoꞌo fureranadu ihohiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa daꞌo hegoteꞌohe.

E ibite Damaseko azaḡa mazao, Ierusalema azaḡa mazao, Iudea haba azaḡa niduꞌa mazao, ebu Iuda mene azaḡa mazao zuni ꞌahige rae haramiro, 'Zamaze ḡihunadu Badiꞌa vaḡe aroꞌi. Ebu haḡai manoḡa haḡaeꞌenaꞌa, zamaze ḡihunateꞌe furenoꞌi.'
Eḡeꞌa ꞌougiroteꞌe uꞌano, Iuda azaḡaniꞌa kuru neḡano obohe teadu uḡuhe ruhihi reiro.

Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa danahe onao izidi, e ꞌada edauꞌohe, ebu vaze komeꞌanonoꞌo boro ḡonaga zeḡe niduꞌa mazao hari tiba hina rae fureneꞌohe. Eꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe peroveta azaḡa zu Moseꞌa vesuꞌu naginiꞌa fureraꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa.
Ze ꞌahige rae fureniro, 'Kerisoꞌa aduga hidiꞌuma, ebu rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano ibite bare ḡabodiꞌuma, ebu aneꞌa Iuda azaḡa zu Iuda mene azaḡa mazao ḡabone hiditeꞌe agaḡaḡa haramiꞌuma.'”
Pauloꞌe ꞌouge reirotene, Fesitoꞌa ḡihau ḡoeriro, “Paulo! Ḡa baboraneha! Ḡae edeḡa ufeta boroꞌa ḡa mae baboꞌeha.”
Rehano Pauloꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡihiꞌa vazeḡa Fesito, eꞌe mene baboraneha. Eḡeꞌa raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe hube zu edaꞌeḡa.
Kini Agiripaꞌe ꞌahi niduꞌa edeḡa ꞌahine, eꞌe mene rihauꞌenaꞌa huga ḡoereꞌohe. Eꞌe edeḡa, kini Agiripaꞌe ꞌahi niduꞌa igi hauḡiro, mazaḡa eꞌeguḡaniꞌa guniꞌa neḡano mene fureraro.
Kini Agiripa, ḡa peroveta azaḡa ḡoere mae ḡihineꞌehe? E edeḡa, ḡa mae ḡihineꞌohe.”
Ebu Agiripaꞌa Paulo niro, “Ḡa mada futuꞌano ḡoere tahiḡa rae furenadu eḡeꞌa Keriso mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa reꞌuma rae raꞌehe?”
Pauloꞌa naenaeniro, “Mada futuꞌa ga faḡaꞌe ago zamaroꞌi. E ḡa zu ꞌada igiꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa eḡe teigoga veize Badiꞌa mazao kurauꞌohe. E ḡuꞌa neḡano ohohirotaꞌaꞌe ahiḡa.”
ꞌOugadu kini Agiripa, gavana vazeḡa Fesito, zu Berenike, ebu eꞌea ehore radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa iḡune edaro.
Ze nu'onu'o neḡanonoꞌo buanadu ḡoretitiro, “Vaze ꞌahiꞌe runeo tuḡuniteꞌe ga ḡuꞌa neḡano ohoniteꞌe haḡaiḡa sauꞌa mene haḡairo.”
Ebu kini Agiripaꞌa Fesito niro, “Vaze ꞌahiꞌe Roma kiniḡaniꞌa kotanoga mene uratifone, ani ḡuꞌa neḡanonoꞌo mae bunifo.”
